method.purpose: Test one target-alignment hypothesis: does the unchanged price-feature ridge method help monthly new money when it learns the actual one-year value of waiting five sessions instead of the five-session liquidation difference? This adds no new predictor information and does not promise an advantage.
method.targetPreference: The user selected monthly new money versus fixed-date investing. Holding-period preference was asked asynchronously but has not been answered. One year remains the explicit provisional primary horizon from earlier research; three years is auxiliary. Do not interpret silence as user confirmation or select a horizon after observing results.
method.priorExposure: The trend score, historical similarity score, seven v1 waiting rules, v2 five-session predictor, and the 1/10/20-day and 1/3-year scope audit have all been examined on this history. This is another registered historical study, not a genuinely untouched holdout. No formal correction for the entire adaptive research search is claimed; all prior failures remain unchanged.

model.featureDefinition: Exactly v2 buildFeatures: daily constant-weight CNY reference including 40% zero-interest strategic cash, inclusive MA200 deviation, running all-history drawdown, five/21-session simple returns and sample SD of the latest 21 simple daily reference returns. Fractions, not percentage points. Reference is only a feature source, not the tradable account.
model.labelEnd: H(s) is the first actual common close on or after the one-calendar-year anniversary of the original funding date s, at most 14 calendar days later. February 29 clamps to February 28. Require s+5<=H(s) and complete finite features at s-1; absent or not-yet-observed endpoints do not produce labels.
model.label: y_s = (1-0.001)/(1+0.001) * sum_j [originalWeight_j * CNY_price_j(H(s)) * (1/CNY_price_j(s+5) - 1/CNY_price_j(s))]. Original weights are 0.3 and 0.3, not normalized 0.5/0.5. This is delayed-minus-immediate one-year net terminal wealth divided by the whole deposit. Identical strategic cash cancels in the zero-interest base scenario.
model.labelUnits: Fraction of the full original deposit. 100*y is the terminal difference in percentage points of total funding; 10000*y is basis points of the full deposit, not of the product budget.
model.causality: Training feature for arrival s is at s-1. Prediction for arrival t uses features at t-1 and only labels with H(s)<=t-1. Sort mature-label events by (exitIndex, entryIndex), insert every newly mature label once, including multiple labels with the same endpoint. Do not replace a calendar year with 252 sessions or reuse v2's five-day maturation index.
model.training: Expanding pool of all eligible, fully mature daily one-year labels. At least 756 labels. Standardize features using only this pool's means and population SD; zero-variance columns map to zero. Center y, unpenalized intercept, objective mean squared error + 1*sum(beta^2). No rolling-window search, clipping, winsorization, sign inversion or hyperparameter search.
model.prediction: trainingMeanY + standardizedCurrentFeatures dot beta; use the same fixed v2 numerical ridge solver without changing its objective.
model.policy: Each deposit makes one decision from its own preceding-close prediction: predicted y>1e-12 delays its complete 60% product-and-fee budget exactly five common closes; otherwise invest at arrival. Keep 40% strategic cash. Never re-predict during the wait, use future deposits, or change an order to fit the terminal date.
model.stress: Base predictions and decisions are fixed for every cash/fee stress scenario. Do not refit labels or thresholds under stress.

method.trainingPoolHash: initial SHA256(empty UTF8 string); on each sorted label event hash(previous lowercase hex + newline + JSON.stringify(full label)); prediction stores current prefix hash
method.precision: Every numeric gate requires a finite value; null, undefined, nonfinite and empty/insufficient evidence fail, including nonnegative transfer/account checks. Counts are exact nonnegative integers, action share thresholds are fractions in [0,1] with no monetary tolerance. Monetary and risk gates operate on unrounded percentage-point values; >= gates allow only 1e-10 absolute floating-rounding tolerance. Strict positivity for wins, concentration, stress means and interval lower bounds means >1e-10 percentage points. Action threshold remains the fixed 1e-12 deposit fraction.

evaluations.primary: Nominal day 1, equal_age_lot, holdingYears=1. Each unique monthly deposit has one common one-year endpoint and one pair of outcomes. Include unchanged/immediate decisions as exact zero improvement; do not discard them from the unconditional result.
evaluations.calendarMeaning: Cash is available only at the designated calendar day's first actual common close in that same month, as in the scope audit. This is a hypothetical funding schedule, not a claim about the user's payday.
evaluations.warmup: Exclude an entire paired account if any required arrival lacks a v3 prediction. All four strategies share the resulting eligibility and actual funding dates.
evaluations.allResults: Report all 108 calendar/scope/horizon/partition/scenario cells, including empty cells and full exclusion reasons. No new winner selection among dates or horizons.
evaluations.accountScope: The twelve-deposit account is an additional necessary non-inferiority check, not the same estimand as each lot held one year. Three-year accounts are auxiliary; short samples and missing outcomes cannot be substituted or stretched to obtain confirmation.
evaluations.predictionDiagnostics: On distinct eligible primary monthly dates, compare forecast MAE/MSE with the mean of exactly the same mature training pool. These diagnostics cannot substitute for actual paired wealth improvement. Record trainingN, featureDay, latestTrainingExit, predicted full-deposit basis points and the fixed action.
